heading: What's new in doXmind
subtitle: Every improvement, new feature, and fix — tracked and documented. Follow the evolution of your writing assistant.

cta.heading: Try the latest features today
cta.description: Every update is available instantly. Start writing with AI for free.

v1_7_8.title: Editor Quality & Safety
v1_7_8.summary: A broad quality pass: opening a shared Markdown file can no longer run script, several data-loss bugs are fixed, and the portable .md is more faithful.
added: CSV files open in the spreadsheet editor with formulas and formatting
Clipboard copy now yields real Markdown — lists, tables, quotes, math
fixed: Opening a downloaded Markdown file can no longer execute script; your file on disk is left untouched
Block-selection Backspace, file switching, HTML comments, and table operations no longer lose data
Page links, images, escaping, and Find/Replace now round-trip faithfully through the .md
improved: Slash-menu search ranks exact matches first and works across spaces
Table and layout columns are resizable; focus and Escape behave correctly

v1_7_7.title: CSV Spreadsheets & Editor Polish
v1_7_7.summary: CSV files open in the full spreadsheet editor with formulas and formatting, and the markdown editor gets Notion-grade slash-menu search.
added: Open .csv files in the spreadsheet editor — edits persist beside the file, the original CSV stays untouched, and exports download as .xlsx
CSV file association on macOS and Windows
improved: Slash-menu search ranks results by match quality and keeps working across spaces (/2 columns, /link to page)
Block menus show platform-correct shortcuts on macOS (⌘D)
Broken images show a clean placeholder with one-click Replace
The deprecated database block is fully removed; legacy sidecar data is preserved untouched

v1_7_6.title: In-App Update Push
v1_7_6.summary: Updates now download silently and surface as a quiet 'Update ready' pill in the sidebar — one click restarts into the new version. Settings → About gains live update controls.
added: Update ready pill — staged updates appear above the sidebar's Settings row; click to restart and apply
Live update controls in Settings → About: check, download progress, up-to-date and restart states
improved: Background update downloads no longer interrupt you with a modal dialog
Long file paths on the welcome screen's recent list are compacted (home as ~, deep paths middle-ellipsized)

v1_7_5.title: Importer Fidelity & Desktop Hardening
v1_7_5.summary: Externally-authored Markdown now opens with full fidelity — strikethrough, nested lists, and Mermaid diagrams all render correctly — plus a locked-down asset protocol and a Windows reliability fix.
improved: Local asset loading is now confined to your workspace folders, hardening the desktop shell against malicious documents
Windows now uses a real cross-process lock during sidecar migration, preventing rare concurrent-migration corruption
fixed: Strikethrough (~~text~~) in existing Markdown files rendered as literal tildes instead of struck-through text
Two-space nested lists were flattened into siblings when opening externally-authored Markdown — and could be saved back flat after editing
Mermaid code fences rendered as plain code blocks instead of diagrams when opening Markdown files

v1_1.title: Database Blocks & Rich Content
v1_1.summary: Notion-style databases, inline comments, multi-column layouts, web bookmarks, page links, cover images, and improved editor experience.
added: Database Blocks — create structured databases with table, board, gallery, and list views, custom properties, and CSV export
Inline Comments — highlight text to leave comments, with resolve and unresolve support
Multi-Column Layouts — arrange content in 2, 3, or 4 columns for flexible page designs
Web Bookmarks — embed links with automatic title, description, and thumbnail previews
Page Links — link between pages with live title sync that stays up to date
Cover Images — add cover images to pages from a preset gallery, file upload, or URL
Chat @Mentions — mention documents and data files directly in chat for quick context
Breadcrumb Navigation — always see where you are in your folder and page hierarchy
Avatar Upload — upload a profile photo that doesn't count against your storage quota
improved: Smarter editor menus that stay within the screen on all devices
Mobile long-press context menu and compact image toolbar
Smoother scroll-past-end and auto-scroll during inline AI edits
Unified share links (/s/) for cleaner, shorter URLs
Real-time cross-page sync for bookmarks, forks, and reactions
PDF and DOCX export now includes title pages and cover images
fixed: Login redirect loops caused by stale authentication cookies
AI buttons and social features incorrectly shown to logged-out visitors
Security hardening for image downloads and bookmark previews

v1_0.title: Subscriptions & Premium
v1_0.summary: Introducing paid plans, premium themes, avatar frames, and a usage dashboard — plus a new official domain.
added: Subscription Plans — choose from Free, Pro, or Max with easy online payment
AI Credits — track your AI usage with a clear credit balance and storage limits per plan
Premium Themes — unlock 8 beautiful color themes like Champagne Gold and Lavender Mist
Avatar Frames — animated profile frames for Pro and Max subscribers
Usage Dashboard — visual charts showing your AI usage and remaining credits
Thinking Mode — AI takes extra time to reason through complex requests for better answers
Chat Regenerate & Edit — retry AI responses, or edit and resend your previous messages
improved: Faster, more affordable web search powered by Google
New official address: app.doxmind.com
Activity dashboard now tracks characters written instead of edit count
fixed: Subscription not activating after payment in some cases
AI edits sometimes applied to the wrong part of the document

v0_9.title: Multilingual, Email Signup & Social
v0_9.summary: Full Chinese and English interface, email registration, social features like follows and notifications, and a China server for faster access.
added: Multilingual Interface — full Chinese and English support across the entire app
Email Registration — sign up with email, verify with a code, and recover your password
More Secure Sessions — login stays active longer while keeping your account safe
Social Features — follow other users, get real-time notifications, and react to shared documents with emoji
China Server — dedicated server in China for faster access
Inline AI Assistant — quick AI edits right where you're writing
improved: Smarter document search for the AI assistant
Better mobile popups and bottom sheets

v0_8.title: New Editor & Themes
v0_8.summary: A faster, more powerful editor with 8 beautiful themes, click-to-edit blocks, precise change tracking, and an AI assistant that works across all your documents.
added: Faster Editor Engine — upgraded for better performance, smoother typing, and more reliable saving
8 Writer Themes — 4 light and 4 dark themes to match your mood, with automatic dark mode switching
Click-to-Edit Blocks — click on images, formulas, or diagrams to edit them in place with a handy toolbar
Precise Change Tracking — see exactly which words changed with live preview as AI edits your document
Cross-Document AI — ask the AI assistant questions across all your documents at once
AI Usage Breakdown — see how much AI you're using across chat, autocomplete, editing, and more
AI Slide Simplification — automatically condense long documents into concise presentation slides
improved: Smarter AI editing that makes more precise, targeted changes
More AI model options to choose from

v0_7.title: Community Hub
v0_7.summary: Discover and share documents in a new community feed, with comments, bookmarks, user profiles, personalized recommendations, and diagram support.
added: Community Page — browse, comment on, bookmark, and remix documents shared by others
User Profiles — personal pages with bio, social links, and your published documents
For You Recommendations — personalized document suggestions based on your interests
Redesigned Feed — a modern, animated feed with tabs for trending, latest, and recommendations
Diagram Support — create flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and more directly in your documents
Folder Sharing — share an entire folder of documents with a single link
Edit After Publishing — update the title, description, and tags of shared documents anytime
improved: Faster, more reliable servers with better uptime
Documents load faster with smart on-demand loading

v0_6.title: Presentation Mode
v0_6.summary: Present your documents as full-screen slideshows, plus a new help center and dark mode improvements.
added: Presentation Mode — turn any document into a full-screen slideshow with keyboard and swipe navigation
New Landing Page — a redesigned homepage showcasing doXmind's features
Help Center — learn about all features with customizable font and layout settings
Shared Document Outline — a table of contents sidebar when reading shared documents
Dark Mode Improvements — smoother, more consistent dark theme across the app
fixed: Dashboard not scrolling properly on some screens
Dropdown menus not highlighting on hover
Connection issues with some server configurations

v0_5.title: Block Editor & Onboarding
v0_5.summary: A richer editing experience with drag-and-drop blocks, an interactive welcome tour, and customizable fonts.
added: Drag-and-Drop Blocks — grab and reorder any block, plus row and column controls for tables
Welcome Tour — an interactive step-by-step guide for new users
Custom Fonts — choose your preferred font, size, and line spacing
Trash Bin — deleted files go to a recoverable trash instead of being permanently removed
Cloud Image Hosting — images are now stored reliably in the cloud
New Content Blocks — callout boxes, dividers, and more to enrich your documents
Resizable Panels & Focus Mode — drag to resize sidebars, plus a distraction-free writing mode
Visual Refresh — updated look and feel across the entire app
improved: Better server stability and security

v0_4.title: Smart Editor & File Organization
v0_4.summary: AI that answers questions across all your documents, folder organization, math formula support, and smart autocomplete.
added: Ask AI Across Documents — ask questions and get answers that draw from all your files
Improved Change Review — easily navigate and approve or reject AI-suggested changes one by one
Folders — organize your files into folders with drag-and-drop
Math Formulas — write inline and block-level math equations with LaTeX
Smart Autocomplete — three modes (quick, detailed, and adaptive) that suggest text as you write
Shareable File Links — each file has its own URL for easy sharing and bookmarking
improved: More precise AI text editing
Smoother, faster chat experience
Cleaner, more consistent interface

v0_3.title: Security, Mobile & Dashboard
v0_3.summary: Use your own AI key, a new home dashboard, mobile editing, and stronger account security.
added: Bring Your Own API Key — use your own AI provider key for custom model access
Home Dashboard — a new home page showing all your recent files at a glance
Mobile Editing — edit documents on your phone with a responsive layout and outline navigation
Stronger Security — improved login and session protection
improved: Cleaner codebase for faster performance

v0_2.title: Platform Foundation
v0_2.summary: Upload data files, try the product in demo mode, and reliable behind-the-scenes updates.
added: Data File Upload — upload CSV, Excel, and JSON files to analyze with AI
Demo Mode — try out AI features without signing up
Reliable Updates — a new system to ensure smooth feature rollouts

v0_1.title: Intelligent Search
v0_1.summary: The foundation of doXmind — powerful search combining keyword and AI-powered matching, writing skills, and file favorites.
added: Powerful Search — find anything instantly with combined keyword and AI-powered search
Search Your Documents — the same powerful search works across all your uploaded files
Faster Indexing — documents are indexed in parallel for near-instant searchability
Smarter Chat Memory — longer conversations without losing context or slowing down
Writing Skills — built-in writing aids including legal case lookup
File Summaries & Favorites — auto-generate file summaries and mark important files
Usage Tracking — monitor your AI usage per conversation
improved: Better PDF export for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean documents
More accurate search results
